notable_absence.finding: No edition badge, storage-engine mention, or server-version-string citation - both known recurring anomalies absent, as expected for a UI-procedure page.

cross_component_finding: Third and cleanest confirmation in this batch of the two-tier data-access role split: Data Reader gates read-only document viewing, Data Writer gates the full create/edit/delete set, on the exact same UI feature (a single-role-per-capability split, not disjunctive). This directly parallels import-data-documents.json's single Data Writer gate (a write-only feature, so only the write-side role applies) and contrasts with data-service.md's separate Project Owner/Cluster Manager gate for bucket/scope/collection *administration* - confirming a stable, batch-wide two-axis role model: administration roles (Project Owner, Cluster Manager) vs data-access roles (Data Reader, Data Writer), applied consistently across bucket creation, document CRUD, and data import.
